description: Preserve mutable access before Vec indexing, shared reads, field projections, and independent copied values.
A stored mutable reference cannot bypass immutable Vec indexing.
Shared array access remains blocked across later indexing through a mutable reference.
Shared Vec access remains blocked across later indexing through a mutable reference.
Field access must preserve the immutable Vec indexing restriction.
Field access must preserve a shared array dereference restriction.
Array indexing cannot discard an outer immutable Vec restriction.
Box and mutable-reference autodereferences cannot bypass immutable Vec indexing.
An immutable Box owner cannot provide mutable access to its Vec.
A reference to an inner Vec cannot bypass immutable access to the outer Vec.
Compound assignment also respects the inherited mutation restriction.
